title: Level 49
text: Sofia likes Roblox, and her favourite game is an obby.
In an obby, players jump from block to block and try not to fall.
The red blocks are lava, so you must not touch them.
Sofia was at level 49 for a week.
Every time she fell into the lava, she started again.
Today her little brother took the tablet and finished the level in two minutes.
Sofia isn't talking to him now.
